mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO group_link ( tenant_id, id, link_url, group_name, origin, membership_state, sync_protocol_mask, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{tenantId}, #{row.groupLinkId}, #{row.linkUrl}, #{row.insertGroupName}, #{row.origin}, #{row.membershipState}, #{row.syncProtocolMask}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted_at = NULL, group_name = CASE
WHEN VALUES(link_url) = #{row.linkUrl} THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{row.observedGroupName}), ''), group_name)
ELSE group_name END, membership_state = CASE WHEN membership_state = 3 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, sync_protocol_mask = CASE WHEN sync_protocol_mask = 0 THEN VALUES(sync_protocol_mask) WHEN sync_protocol_mask = VALUES(sync_protocol_mask) THEN sync_protocol_mask ELSE 3 END, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE group_link SET deleted_at = NULL, group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupName}), ''), group_name), membership_state = CASE WHEN membership_state = 3 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, sync_protocol_mask = CASE WHEN sync_protocol_mask = 0 THEN #{syncProtocolMask} WHEN sync_protocol_mask = #{syncProtocolMask} THEN sync_protocol_mask ELSE 3 END, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{groupLinkId}
mapper.select: SELECT handle.id FROM wa_group_invite current_invite INNER JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = current_invite.tenant_id AND handle.group_invite_id = current_invite.id AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE current_invite.invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND current_invite.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY current_invite.updated_at DESC, handle.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE group_link SET deleted_at = NULL, label_id = #{labelId}, import_batch_id = #{batchId}, group_name = COALESCE(#{groupName}, group_name), updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE group_link SET label_id = #{labelId}, import_batch_id = #{batchId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND label_id IS NULL

UPDATE group_link SET deleted_at = NULL, label_id = NULL, import_batch_id = NULL, group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupName}), ''), group_name), origin = 4, membership_state = 3, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM group_link WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT handle.id AS groupLinkId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, COALESCE(current_invite.invite_code, input_invite.invite_code) AS inviteCode FROM group_link handle LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND current_group.id = handle.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite current_invite ON current_invite.tenant_id = current_profile.tenant_id AND current_invite.id = current_profile.current_invite_id AND current_invite.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite input_invite ON input_invite.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND input_invite.id = handle.group_invite_id AND input_invite.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE handle.id = #{id} AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT link.id FROM group_link link LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND current_group.id = link.group_id WHERE link.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( current_group.group_jid = #{groupJid} OR link.link_url = CONCAT('wa://group/', #{groupJid}) ) ORDER BY link.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT tenantId, groupLinkId, groupJid, accountId, protocolAccountId FROM ( SELECT g.tenant_id AS tenantId, g.id AS groupLinkId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, current_profile.last_checked_at AS lastCheckAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY g.tenant_id, g.id ORDER BY r.is_admin DESC, r.id ASC ) AS rowNo FROM group_link g INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND current_group.id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = current_group.id INNER JOIN join_task_result r ON r.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND r.group_jid = current_group.group_jid AND r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.account_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.id = r.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND a.protocol_account_id != '' INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} WHERE g.deleted_at IS NULL AND current_group.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND current_group.group_jid != '' AND (current_profile.banned IS NULL OR current_profile.banned = 0) ) ranked WHERE rowNo = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(lastCheckAt, 0) ASC, groupLinkId ASC LIMIT #{limit}
